item.title: Notice of Joint Public Hearing: 11/9/2026; for the Installation, Operation and Management of an Outdoor Holiday Gift Market at Union Square Park, Manhattan (Solicitation # M89-AS-2025)
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Public Hearings and Meetings | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-09 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation will hold a joint public hearing on Nov. 9, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. at 255 Greenwich Street in Manhattan on its intent to award Urban Space Holdings, Inc. a five-year permit to run an outdoor holiday gift market at Union Square Park.

NOTICE OF A JOINT PUBLIC HEARING of the Franchise and Concession Review Committee and The Department of Parks & Recreation (Parks) to be held on 11/9/2026, at 255 Greenwich Street, 8th Floor, in Manhattan  commencing at 2:30 p.m.  relative to:

INTENT TO AWARD as a concession a Permit Agreement (Permit) to Urban Space Holdings, Inc. (Permitee) for the Installation, Operation and Management of an Outdoor Holiday Gift Market at Union Square Park, Manhattan, NY 10011 (Solicitation # M89-AS-2025)

The Permit will provide for a five (5) year term with no options to renew.

Compensation to the City will be as follows:

item.title: 84627B0012-Maintenance and Repair of Automated Logic WebCTRL and Carrier
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-09 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking sealed bids, due Nov. 9, 2026, from vendors to maintain and repair Automated Logic WebCTRL and Carrier I-Vu building automation systems at Parks facilities citywide.

The work to be performed under this contract includes furnishing all labor, materials, travel time, equipment and all other work incidental thereto necessary or required to provide the complete testing, maintenance and repair of Automated Logic WebCTRL and Carrier I-Vu Building Automation systems and equipment (systems and equipment) at various NYC Parks facilities Citywide. This Request for Bids is released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this CSB must be submitted via PASSPort.

To access the CSB, vendors should visit the PASSPort public Portal at https://www1.nyc.gov/site/mocs/systems/about-go-to-passport.page and click on the Search Funding Opportunities in PASSPort blue box. Doing so will take one to the public portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the CSB, insert the EPIN, 84627B0012, into the Keyword search field. In order to respond to the CSB, vendors must create an account within the PASSPort system if they have not already done so. The Bid Opening date will be on November 9th, 2026 at 3:00pm. The Bid Opening will be accessible through a Microsoft TEAMS call. Please go to Passport link and dow…

item.title: AED and CPR Training, AED Inspection and Monitoring
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Award | $914K | Vendor: CPR Courses International LLC In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded CPR Courses International LLC a $913,500 contract for AED and CPR training of Parks staff and annual inspection and maintenance of Parks defibrillator units, through a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

The work to be performed under this Agreement includes furnishing all labor, materials, travel time, transportation and equipment and all other Work incidental thereto necessary or required for the Automated External Defibrillator (AED) and CPR training of NYC Parks Staff, as well as the annual inspection, monitoring, and maintenance of Parks AED units.

item.title: MG-126M Manhattan Street Tree Planting FY27
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-06 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking bids for MG-126M, a Manhattan street tree planting project for fiscal year 2027, with competitive sealed bids due Nov. 6, 2026, and a public bid opening that day at 11:30 a.m. via Zoom.

This Procurement is subject to: Section 6-129 of the New York City Administrative Code. Bid Submissions must be submitted in PASSPort.Bid Opening will be held on November 6, 2026 at 11:30am via Zoom Link. Bid documents are available online for free through NYC PASSPortSystem https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/about-passport.page To download the bid solicitation documents (including drawings if any) you must have a NYC ID Account and Login.

item.title: Fire Alarm Monitoring, Maintenance, and Repair
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Award | $2.3M | Vendor: Cronos Fire and Electrical Corp In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Cronos Fire and Electrical Corp a $2,310,306 contract through competitive sealed bids to monitor, maintain, repair and test fire alarm systems at agency facilities across the five boroughs.

The work to be performed under this contract includes furnishing all labor, materials, travel time, equipment and all other work incidental thereto necessary or required to provide the complete repair, monitoring, maintenance, inspection and testing of Agency fire detection devices, equipment and systems at Agency facilities located throughout the Citys five (5) boroughs. All work designed, filed, performed and materials furnished under this Contract shall conform to the applicable requirements of the appropriate corresponding rules and regulations including without limitation the New York City Department of Buildings (DOB), New York City Fire Department (FDNY), and National Fire Protection Association Code 72 (NFPA 72).

item.title: EAB in Brooklyn and Staten Island
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Award | $1.9M | Vendor: Arborist Services by Dujets Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Arborist Services by Dujets Inc a $1,943,940 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to treat and prune ash trees infested with or at risk from emerald ash borer in Brooklyn and Staten Island.

The work to be performed under this contract includes furnishing all labor materials, travel time, equipment and all other work incidental thereto necessary or required to treat and prune trees that have been or could become infested by Emerald Ash Borer (Agrilus planipennis) (EAB), as directed by the Project Manager, in the borough of Brooklyn and Staten Island, for the City of New York Parks & Recreation (Agency).

item.title: Construction Management Services for NYC Parks, Citywide
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-02 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking proposals from qualified firms for construction management and consulting services on City-owned properties across the five boroughs, on an as-needed basis, with responses due Nov. 2, 2026.

NYCs Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking qualified firms to perform comprehensive construction management services, partial construction management services, or consulting services for various City-owned properties located within the five boroughs, on an as needed basis. Request for Proposal (RFP) documents are available online for free through the NYC PASSPort System https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/about-passport.page You must have a NYC ID Account and Login. Submissions must be submitted through PASSPort. Please visit the following link to view the documents for this solicitation and for further details. https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/bpm/process_manage_extranet/38665 Any inquiries concerning this solicitation should be directed by email to rfpsubmissions@parks.nyc.gov, with the subject line EPIN: 84627P0003 Construction Management RFP.
